title: Start Before You're Ready
body: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great. The morning is a fresh canvas. Do not wait for the perfect moment; take the moment and make it perfect.

questions.question: What is the main message of the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage encourages starting immediately rather than waiting.

title: The 1% Rule
body: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out. If you get just 1% better every single day, by the end of the year, you will be 37 times better than who you are today.

questions.question: What happens if you get 1% better daily?
options: You become 37x better in a year
questions.explanation: The compound effect of small daily improvements is massive.
